integrity: Mathematical proof and independently implemented finite checks are supplied; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one-hub unions of disjoint nonempty cliques, not to arbitrary block graphs.
Counts globally or inclusion-minimal defensive alliances, not locally minimal or dominating defensive alliances.
Unrestricted correctness rests on proof; the finite verifier is corroboration.
Full text of one relevant optimization paper was inaccessible; priority remains provisional.
title: Globally minimal defensive alliances of clique windmills: exact enumeration and a parity cutoff
